title: 认识危险物品：七大类和它们藏在哪
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/48_What are the Hazardous Materials hazardous material trending laboratory raqbamic.md

points.K2: 固液气都有，五种方式伤人

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排空白标签的瓶罐前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of bottles and cans with blank labels and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这些瓶瓶罐罐，哪些有危险？
overlay: 认识危险物品：七大类和它们藏在哪

shots.scene: 七个彩色格子依次亮起，每格一个危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: Seven colored boxes light up one by one, each with a hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 今天认识危险物品的七大类。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进实验室，看着满柜的瓶子发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student on his first day in the lab stares at a cabinet full of bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，看花了眼。

shots.scene: 阿杰随手拿起一瓶，翻来覆去看，旁边红色问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a bottle and turns it around; a red question mark appears.
shots.narration: 他问：这些东西哪个危险？

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指向瓶身上的菱形象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over and points at the diamond pictogram on the bottle.
shots.narration: 小研说：先学会认出它们。

shots.scene: 菱形象形图组成一面墙：火焰、骷髅、腐蚀、气瓶等
shots.prompt_en: A wall made of red-bordered diamond pictograms: flame, skull, corrosion, gas cylinder and more. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物品，俗称危险品。

shots.scene: 三个图标：人体、房屋、树木，各被一道红色闪电指着
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a human figure, a house and a tree, each targeted by a red lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 它会伤害人体、财产或环境。

shots.scene: 三个圆圈：烧瓶、微生物、能量波，箭头汇向危险标志
shots.prompt_en: Three circles with a flask, a microbe and an energy wave, with arrows converging on a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 原因在于化学、生物或物理性质。

shots.section_title: 固液气都有，五种方式伤人
shots.scene: 一块方块、一滴液滴、一团气雾并排
shots.prompt_en: A solid block, a liquid drop and a gas cloud side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 它可以是固体、液体或气体。
overlay: 固液气都有，五种方式伤人

shots.section_title: 固液气都有，五种方式伤人
shots.scene: 五个小图标依次出现：洒出、吸入、入口、接触、乱放
shots.prompt_en: Five small icons appear one by one: a spill, a nose inhaling, a mouth, a hand touching, a messy shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 洒出、吸入、误食、接触、乱处理。

shots.scene: 火焰象形图放大，旁边是汽油罐和酒精瓶
shots.prompt_en: A flame pictogram enlarges, next to a fuel can and an alcohol bottle with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 第一类：易燃和可燃物。

shots.scene: 一个瓶口飘出淡淡蒸气，靠近火花时闪起火光
shots.prompt_en: Faint vapor drifts from an open bottle and flashes into flame near a spark. No people.
shots.narration: 很容易着火，甚至爆炸。

shots.scene: 四个瓶罐图标：油罐、酒精瓶、小气罐、溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a fuel can, an alcohol bottle, a small gas canister, a solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 比如汽油、乙醇、丙烷、丙酮。

shots.scene: 腐蚀象形图：液滴滴在手和金属片上
shots.prompt_en: The corrosion pictogram: drops falling on a hand and a metal plate. No people.
shots.narration: 第二类：腐蚀性物质。

shots.scene: 金属片被液滴蚀出小坑，皮肤图标泛红
shots.prompt_en: A metal plate gets pitted by drops and a skin icon turns red. No people.
shots.narration: 会伤害皮肤和眼睛，腐蚀金属。

shots.scene: 三个试剂瓶图标：两瓶酸、一瓶碱
shots.prompt_en: Three reagent bottle icons: two acid bottles and one base bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 比如盐酸、硫酸、氢氧化钠。

shots.scene: 骷髅象形图放大
shots.prompt_en: The skull and crossbones pictogram enlarges. No people.
shots.narration: 第三类：有毒物质。

shots.scene: 三个图标：鼻子吸入、嘴巴入口、皮肤渗入
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a nose inhaling, a mouth swallowing, skin absorbing. No people.
shots.narration: 吸入、误食、经皮吸收都会中毒。

shots.scene: 三个图标：带锁的瓶子、农药喷壶、温度计样式的瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a locked bottle, a pesticide sprayer, a silver liquid bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 比如氰化物、农药、汞化合物。

shots.scene: 爆炸象形图放大
shots.prompt_en: The exploding bomb pictogram enlarges. No people.
shots.narration: 第四类：反应性和爆炸性物质。

shots.scene: 三个图标：空气、水滴、另一瓶试剂，各连一道闪光
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, air, a water drop and another reagent bottle, each linked to a sudden flash. No people.
shots.narration: 它不稳定，遇空气、水或别的物质会剧烈反应。

shots.scene: 三个空白标签的瓶子，其中两个贴着带锁图标
shots.prompt_en: Three bottles with blank labels, two of them marked with a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如硝酸铵、过氧化物、苦味酸。

shots.scene: 电离辐射标志放大，旁边一个黄色金属桶
shots.prompt_en: The ionizing radiation warning sign enlarges, next to a yellow metal drum. No people.
shots.narration: 第五类：放射性物质。

shots.scene: 射线穿过细胞图标，细胞里的双螺旋断开
shots.prompt_en: Rays pass through a cell icon and the double helix inside breaks. No people.
shots.narration: 它发出的射线能损伤细胞和 DNA。

shots.scene: 三个带辐射标志的铅罐图标
shots.prompt_en: Three lead container icons with radiation symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 比如铀、镭、钴-60。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志放大
shots.prompt_en: The biohazard warning sign enlarges. No people.
shots.narration: 第六类：生物危害。

shots.scene: 四个图标：杆状细菌、球形病毒、霉菌丝、小瓶毒素
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a rod-shaped bacterium, a round virus, a mold filament, a small toxin vial. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌、病毒、真菌和生物毒素。

shots.scene: 微生物图标与人体图标之间画着病菌传播的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows lead from a microbe icon to a human figure icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它们能让人和动物生病。

shots.scene: 一排彩色气瓶，气瓶象形图放大
shots.prompt_en: A row of colored gas cylinders; the gas cylinder pictogram enlarges. No people.
shots.narration: 第七类：压缩气体。

shots.scene: 气瓶剖面，里面挤满压缩的小点
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a cylinder packed with tightly compressed dots. No people.
shots.narration: 高压储存，可能爆裂。

shots.scene: 密闭房间里气体扩散，人形图标喘不过气
shots.prompt_en: Gas spreads in a closed room and a human figure icon struggles to breathe. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏还会造成窒息或中毒。

shots.scene: 三个气瓶图标，颜色不同
shots.prompt_en: Three gas cylinder icons in different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 比如氧气、氯气、氨。

shots.scene: 九个菱形标志排成三行三列
shots.prompt_en: Nine diamond-shaped hazard placards arranged in three rows of three. No people.
shots.narration: 运输和储存，有统一的类别标志。

shots.scene: 九个菱形标志逐个亮起，编号一到九
shots.prompt_en: The nine diamond hazard labels light up one by one, each with a large class number from one to nine. No people.
shots.narration: 一共九类，每类一个菱形标志。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照标志卡，认出瓶上的象形图，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares a pictogram card with a bottle label and nods.
shots.narration: 先认标志，就知道该怎么防。

shots.scene: 实验室场景图标亮起，周围飘出酸瓶、溶剂瓶、培养皿
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory icon lights up, surrounded by an acid bottle, a solvent bottle and a petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物品在哪？先说实验室。

shots.scene: 三格画面：酸、溶剂、病原体图标
shots.prompt_en: Three panels with icons for acid, solvent and pathogen. No people.
shots.narration: 酸、有机溶剂、病原微生物。

shots.scene: 医院建筑图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A hospital building icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 医院里，也有不少危险物品。

shots.scene: 三格画面：药瓶、样本管、消毒剂喷瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three panels with a medicine bottle, a sample tube and a disinfectant spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 药品、感染性样本、消毒剂。

shots.scene: 工厂图标亮起，烟囱冒烟
shots.prompt_en: A factory icon lights up with a chimney. No people.
shots.narration: 工厂里用量更大。

shots.scene: 两格画面：化工桶、油罐
shots.prompt_en: Two panels with a chemical drum and a fuel tank. No people.
shots.narration: 工业化学品和燃料。

shots.scene: 一座房子图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A house icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 家里也有危险物品。

shots.scene: 四格画面：清洁剂、油漆罐、电池、杀虫喷雾
shots.prompt_en: Four panels with a cleaning product, a paint can, a battery and an insect spray. No people.
shots.narration: 清洁剂、油漆、电池、杀虫剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，七个格子依次亮起象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where seven boxes light up with pictograms.
shots.narration: 易燃、腐蚀、有毒、反应爆炸。

shots.scene: 后三个格子亮起：辐射、生物危害、气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three more boxes light up with radiation, biohazard and gas cylinder icons.
shots.narration: 放射性、生物危害、压缩气体。

shots.scene: 实验室、医院、工厂、房子四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab, a hospital, a factory and a house in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室、医院、工厂、家里都有。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着试剂柜一一认出象形图，小研竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student identifies pictograms on the cabinet one by one; the female graduate student gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 七大类，四个地方，都要认得清。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张象形图卡片，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pictogram card and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 认清危险，才能远离危险，再见！
